verdict.rationale: Elastic's client docs state that Elasticsearch has a wide range of official libraries and developer tools for most popular programming languages, backed by a forward-compatibility policy so client apps keep working across server upgrades. The quickstart also invites users to index and search in their preferred language. Missing for 10: an enumerated list of supported SDK languages, detail on SDK features or AI-specific helpers, and independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK quality.
